newsitem.title: USA: Meridian slides after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Meridian slides after profit warning.

text.p: Shares of Meridian Diagnostics Inc slid more than 40 percent after the company said its second quarter earnings would fall about 33 percent below Wall Street estimates on Monday.
Shares fell 4-3/8 to 5-3/4 in early trading. The stock was one of the top losers on the Nasdaq on a percent basis.

The company forecast earnings per share of about $0.08 for the second quarter ended March 31, 1997 compared to $0.10 last year. But according to First Call, Wall Street analysts had been estimating second quarter earnings of $0.12 a share.
Meridian makes disposable tests that rapidly diagnose infectious diseases.
The company said it expects second quarter net sales of about $8.34 million, up about $1.08 million or 15 percent over the same period of the prior fiscal year.
